text: Entry Requirements General: 18 years of age or above, in good health with valid Non-Chinese passport, and an educational background of completed high school or above; Applicants from mainland China，Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan should meet the relevant regulations of the ministry of education. Copy of HSK certificate, score at least 180 on the HSK (level 5); (or printed HSK score webpage, original certificate to be checked at registration);transfer students majoring in Chinese language (junior year) should score above HSK6 grade 180; There not required for applicants who have received 12-year Chinese education in Malaysia and Singapore; Test report of the China Scholastic Competency Assessment (CSCA), for detailed subject requirements, please refer to " Catalog of Undergraduate Programs 2026 ".
